tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background: ice white in light, night navy in dark. Also the ground of the dot-grid canvas.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, inputs and the lesson step area.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, menus and popovers above surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: mock-screen frame, progress tracks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, dividers and card borders that carry no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, unselected choices); 3:1 on surface and canvas.

tokens.name: grid-dot
tokens.usage: Dots of the canvas grid pattern. Decorative only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: UXGate navy. Primary text and icons on canvas, surface and the soft fills.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata on canvas, surface and surface-sunken (5.4:1 or more).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: UXGate blue (the logo's door blue). Primary buttons, selection frame and handles, links, active tab.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Pale blue behind selected choices and brand chips.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text on brand-soft, and hover for brand fills.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: The logo gradient's light end. Only in the logo, the gradient and large decorative shapes; never text.

tokens.name: energy
tokens.usage: UXGate cyan: reward. XP, streak, celebration, highlight pills. A fill with on-energy text, never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-energy
tokens.usage: Navy text and icons on a cyan fill.

tokens.name: energy-soft
tokens.usage: Ice cyan behind energy-ink text: XP pills, highlight panels.

tokens.name: energy-ink
tokens.usage: Cyan as text on surface and energy-soft (the subtitle colour of UXGate posts).

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Soft mint panels for concept cards and article teasers, as in UXGate posts. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct answers: icon, border, and text on surface. Always with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the right-answer feedback sheet (shares the brand mint).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text on success-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong answers and destructive actions: icon and border, always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the wrong-answer sheet and error fields.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on danger-soft and error messages on surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warnings with an icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind warning text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid navy (light) or ice (dark) with 2px offset, so it never looks like the blue selection frame.

tokens.name: path-sky
tokens.usage: Path art only (subject colour); the wordmark blue.
